Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for assay CHEMBL1217644. Join molecule_dictionary to activities via molregno, join activities to assays via assay_id, and join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary via molregno as an INNER JOIN. Filter where assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217644', activities.standard_relation = '=', and activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
